sourceLayout: two equal horizontal rows: victory, defeat

transitions.limit: Only observed N to N+1 within the same visible context; first load (including wave 1), jumps and reentry do not play.

transitions.reason: No completed-wave event or outcome in combat HUD state. Next-wave number does not prove completion; final wave 15 is not a victory event.
No invasion event id in combat HUD state. Enemy counts and animation strings are not invasion evidence.
BossId/role describes a snapshot, not a new entrance. Initial loading and encounter changes are baselines.

transitions.limit: Only observed phase N to N+1 for the same mission/encounter/boss; first load is silent.

transitions.reason: RunResultOutcome exists outside HUD but no result/event producer is wired to this combat presentation state. No new result or reward flow introduced.
No terminal outcome in combat HUD state. Down animations or unit counts do not establish defeat.

producerConsumer.productionLimit: Existing callers found for these presentation factories are QA fixtures. New gameplay/API event producer is not added. Screenshots explicitly exercise adjacent snapshot fixtures through the real HUD.
producerConsumer.identityLimit: No run instance or monotonic event id exists in this HUD contract. Identity uses visible mission/encounter/boss context plus progress high-water mark; reset/reentry establishes a silent baseline. This is not durable cross-run event deduplication.

lifecycle.duplicateRender: does not restart fade or audio
lifecycle.rollbackOrJump: clear active presentation and suppress inferred events
lifecycle.cancel: CancelCombatTransition clears label, opacity and dedicated audio without replaying the consumed transition
lifecycle.disable: cancel and reset tracker; next render establishes a silent baseline
lifecycle.audio: dedicated non-looping AudioSource reuses existing clips, so cancellation does not stop unrelated combat audio/BGM
lifecycle.timerPurpose: cosmetic fade/expiration only, never gameplay event generation
lifecycle.layout: 900x96 band in existing gap between exterior and tactical HUD, TMP text separate from art

verification.focusedTransitionTests: 11/11 passed including real Play Mode enter/exit lifecycle within EditMode runner
verification.finalCombinedRegression: 46/46 passed: transitions, status cues/bindings, launch prefab bindings, combat HUD presenter; TestResults-CombatTransition-Verified.xml
